verdict.rationale: Relay's support docs state that outgoing ACH transfers take 1–3 business days and that domestic wires can send same-day with a delivery estimate shown before confirming. Its bill-pay feature lets users pay vendors the way they want to be paid. Community reviews confirm outgoing ACH, including same-day ACH on Pro, and a user notes that external payments are executed manually from the app. Missing for 10: a detailed first-party walkthrough of adding vendor payees and choosing ACH vs wire, and documentation of domestic wire fees and limits.
